reference.method: Read-only disassembly and matching PDB metadata. The executable was not run.

facts.contract: MobEffectIds assigns Jump=8, Levitation=24, SlowFalling=27. SlowFalling initialization uses ID27 and the slow_falling name.

MobMovementGravity::tickDefaultGravity returns without adding gravity when HasGravity bit49 is clear, or when DescendThroughBlock bit71 and either InScaffolding bit69 or OverScaffolding bit70 are set. Otherwise it selects slow gravity only when StateVector.mPosDelta.y is strictly negative and the SlowFalling vector entry is present. Positive velocity and either sign of zero select normal gravity.

The selected ApplyGravityComponent is -0.01f with mResetFallDistance=true for falling with SlowFalling, otherwise -0.08f with false. The ordinary application callback adds component gravity to vertical velocity and sets FallDistanceComponent.mValue to zero when its flag is true. No amplifier is read by this gravity-selection helper.

The ordinary AI-step registration registers JumpFromGround, TriggerJump and ApplyJumpModifier before travel, move requests and the actor-move registration. It then registers automatic climbing, liquid drag, levitation, gravity and normal drag in that order. Gravity selection is not registered before jumping.
anchors: ApplyJumpModifier label RVA0x6825D9E and registration call RVA0x6825DD5

facts.contract: The jump registration and post-travel callback use the same registration adapter and normal-tick mode. The default collection appends each system index to its category vector. Normal ticking iterates that vector from begin to end and invokes each system before advancing. This closes the ordinary registration-order interpretation for this collection; it is not a complete model of replay or every alternate scheduler.
anchors: post-travel callback vtable RVA0xE9A36D0 slot16 -> RVA0x685CEB0
category append RVA0x25C66BF and end increment RVA0x25C66C1

facts.contract: The matched per-entity levitation helper reads effect24, multiplies vertical velocity by 0.8f, then adds float(amplifier+1)*0.01f and adds LevitateTravelFlagComponent. It is registered after ordinary travel/move. Its view metadata lists MobTravel, MobEffects and StateVector and a separate PlayerFlyingTravel component filter. Full coexistence with every travel mode is not claimed here.

The matched player-water gravity callback omits gravity when ActorDataFlag Swimming bit57 is set; otherwise writes -0.005f to ApplyGravityComponent. This callback does not read SlowFalling or its amplifier.

comparison.ordinary_slow_falling_sign_and_values: The existing Perlin helper already uses the matched strict-negative condition and constants in isolation. This investigation does not establish a changed gravity coefficient or pre-jump selection rule.
comparison.incident_log: The incident log records MobEffect packet counts and a disconnect message but not decoded effect IDs, amplifiers, effect durations, packet tick fields, or a full jumping trajectory. It cannot establish the specific server detection rule or prove the causal defect.

limitations: The symbol-backed and scheduling proof is specific to the supplied 1.26.51.1/protocol2193 executable. The incident destination used protocol2225; complete equivalence with 1.26.65.1 is not asserted.
This is a static contract, not an executed native full-tick trajectory or an acceptance test against a server.
All travel-tag membership, collision/fall-distance details, full replay scheduling, and complete gliding/liquid precedence are not reconstructed by this artifact.
Effect packet timing, merge and expiry behavior are a separate investigation.
No claim is made about avoiding bans or satisfying a particular anti-cheat.
